items.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.1 Terra with Enhanced Visual Reasoning
items.why: The announcement of a new flagship GPT model with improved visual reasoning and computer use capabilities is crucial for AI development and application.

items.title: Researchers Explain ChatGPT Account Takeover Exploit
items.why: This details a critical security vulnerability found in ChatGPT's account management, which is vital information for developers building AI-powered platforms.

items.title: Anthropic Developing System to Prove AI Model Identity (FlashProve)
items.why: FlashProve addresses a critical need for AI model provenance and trust, allowing users to verify that an AI response truly came from the claimed model.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Can Interpret Model Weights on a Laptop
items.why: This shows how smaller LLMs can deeply understand and even modify neural network weights, opening doors for novel AI applications and research.

items.title: CrowdStrike Acquires AI Security Startups for ~$500M
items.why: This acquisition highlights the rapidly growing market for securing AI agents and models, indicating a critical and expanding area within cybersecurity.
